The '''Esooma system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sprizen sector/Legends|Sprizen sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]].<ref name="Region" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esooma]],<ref name="Twitter" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Esoomian/Legends|Esoomian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Wanted by Craken" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Esooma system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
